children.game_version: A 'musical directions' game where children move to the color/direction called out by the leader.

seniors.seated_version: Dancers sit in a circle around a central table-top drum, using light sticks to tap the rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Reduced circular walking speed; focus on arm movements with the sticks while standing in place.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo; smaller arm arcs when striking the drum.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Wonmu hold a drumstick in each hand; Hyeopmu hold a flower-shaped stick in each hand
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Eight dancers; four inner (wonmu) and four outer (hyeopmu) surrounding a central drum
movement_profile.partnering: Ensemble coordination between inner and outer circles

signature_moves.description: Main dancers strike the central drum with sticks held in both hands
signature_moves.name: Wonmu drum strike

signature_moves.description: Assisting dancers form an outer circle holding flower-shaped sticks
signature_moves.name: Hyeopmu circling

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking the directional symmetry or the circular formation

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the resonant strikes of a large central drum, accompanied by traditional court music and historical vocalizations of the Jeongeupsa song.

basic_steps: Approach the central drum in a circular path
Wonmu: Raise drumsticks in both hands to strike the drum head
Hyeopmu: Circle the wonmu while holding flower-shaped sticks
Rotate positions according to the cardinal directions (North, South, East, West)
teaching.formation: Concentric circles around a central drum
teaching.level_notes: Requires precise spatial awareness and synchronization between the inner and outer circles.
teaching.rhythm: Courtly and measured, synchronized with the central drum strikes
